entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Me?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I was told you recommended this[n]reassignment yourself, sir.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Why would you choose someone as[n]inexperienced as myself?

entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: When the case of the Shujin principal[n]was ruled a suicide, you thought to[n]reopen it...

entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: And you proved its connection to the[n]Phantom Thieves. This is based primarily[n]on that achievement.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...I'm honored, sir.

entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves issue is now[n]a national crisis.

entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: Expectations are exceedingly high for us[n]public prosecutors, as we are the[n]executors of justice.

entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: Personnel and planning will be up to[n]you on this case. You will also have the[n]police under your command.

entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: I'd like you to oversee this operation.

entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: You've yet to give an answer...

entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: Will you accept the task of eradicating[n]the Phantom Thieves?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I will give it everything I have.

entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: We'll have to prepare a higher position[n]for you as well in the event that you[n]succeed.

entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: I don't wish to apply extra pressure[n]on you...

entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: But I assume your odds of success[n]are high.

entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: Naturally, failure to accomplish this task[n]is unacceptable... Do you understand?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Of course!

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I will live up to your expectations,[n]no matter what it takes!

entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: That is all then. I expect good results[n]from you.
